title: Credit rules and pricing
question: Are the credit rules intended: five times the progress site area, usable only inside the progress project's dates, lost on expiry, and never returned when a visual project ends? Who owns the per-kind prices and minimums, and should they stay in code (one value for every company and contract) or become per-contract data? When is the visual-only price confirmed?
context: Pricing lives in a shared code constant, changed only by a release (BILL-REQ-019). Visual-only projects are switched off "until the price is confirmed" (BILL-REQ-018). Sales overrides allow going beyond the pool (BILL-REQ-014).
options: Per-contract pricing from the order form
